records.name: Bijou's Belongings
records.objectives_text: Find Bijou's Belongings and return them to her. Good luck!

records.name: Message to Maxwell
records.objectives_text: Travel to the and give Bijou's Information to Marshal Maxwell.

records.name: Better Late Than Never
records.objectives_text: The ramblings of the ghostly woman indicated that she needed a package delivered. She claimed that it was where her horse was. As to where the horse is or where the package was to be delivered - the ghost remains incomprehensible.

records.name: Better Late Than Never
records.objectives_text: Check with the Royal Factors of Stormwind to learn the whereabouts of an Emma Felstone. There is usually a census officer located in City Hall.

records.name: Better Late Than Never
records.objectives_text: Check with the Royal Overseers of the Undercity to learn the whereabouts of a Jeremiah Felstone. There is usually a census officer located near guild and tabard registration.

objectives.text: Find and return Crossroads Supply Crates to Thork in the Barrens.

records.name: Pip Quickwit, At Your Service!
records.objectives_text: Talk to Malyfous Darkhammer in Everlook.

objectives.text: Glowing Hunk of the Beast's Flesh (provided)

target.name: Glowing Hunk of the Beast's Flesh
target.page: Glowing Hunk of the Beast's Flesh

records.name: Good Natured Emma
records.objectives_text: Find Ol' Emma in Stormwind and see if she is in fact Emma Felstone. If she is, then perhaps she'd like the package Janice Felstone made for her.

records.name: The Jeremiah Blues
records.objectives_text: Find Jeremiah Payson in the Undercity and see if he is in fact Jeremiah Felstone. If he is, then perhaps he'd like the package Janice Felstone made for him.

records.name: Good Luck Charm
records.objectives_text: Return to Janice Felstone in Western Plaguelands her Good Luck Half-Charm.

prerequisites.wiki_text: Good Natured Emma The Jeremiah Blues

records.name: Two Halves Become One
records.objectives_text: Locate the other half of the Good Luck Charm somewhere on the Felstone Farm in Western Plaguelands and reassemble it. Give the Good Luck Charm to Janice Felstone on the Felstone Farm, Western Plaguelands.

records.name: Blood Shards of Agamaggan
records.objectives_text: Bring a Blood Shard to Mangletooth in Camp Taurajo in the Barrens. Collect more Blood Shards if you want him to bless you with Agamaggan's power.

records.name: Ursius of the Shardtooth
records.objectives_text: Storm Shadowhoof at Everlook in Winterspring wants you to kill him.

records.name: Brumeran of the Chillwind
records.objectives_text: Storm Shadowhoof at Everlook in Winterspring wants you to kill Brumeran.

records.name: Shy-Rotam
records.objectives_text: Storm Shadowhoof at Everlook in Winterspring wants you to defeat Shy-Rotam.

records.name: Past Endeavors
records.objectives_text: Bring Storm Shadowhoof's Marker to Melor Stonehoof in Thunder Bluff.

records.name: Aquatic Form
records.objectives_text: Return to Darnassus and show Mathrengyl Bearwalker the :Pendant of the Sea Lion.

records.name: Sacred Fire
records.objectives_text: Gather 10 bushels of Incendia Agave, and then consult Magatha Grimtotem on Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff.

records.name: Grimtotem Spying
records.objectives_text: Locate and retrieve the three Secret Notes in Darkcloud Pinnacle.

records.name: The Lost Tablets of Mosh'aru
records.objectives_text: Bring the Third and Fourth Mosh'aru Tablets to Prospector Ironboot in Tanaris.

records.name: A Call to Arms: The Plaguelands!

wiki.page: A Call to Arms: The Plaguelands! (Alliance)

records.name: Maxwell's Mission
records.objectives_text: Travel to Blackrock Spire and destroy War Master Voone, Highlord Omokk, and Overlord Wyrmthalak. Return to Marshal Maxwell when the job is done.

records.name: Threat of the Winterfall
records.objectives_text: Donova Snowden in Winterspring wants you to kill 8 Winterfall Pathfinders, 8 Winterfall Den Watchers, and 8 Winterfall Totemics.

records.name: Winterfall Firewater
records.objectives_text: Bring the Empty Firewater Flask to Donova Snowden in Winterspring.

records.name: Falling to Corruption
records.objectives_text: Search the Deadwood furbolg camp in northern Felwood for a clue.

records.name: Mystery Goo
records.objectives_text: Report back to Donova Snowden with your findings.

records.name: Toxic Horrors
records.objectives_text: Collect 3 Toxic Horror Droplets for Donova Snowden in Winterspring.

records.name: Winterfall Runners
records.objectives_text: Find the Winterfall Runners and stop them from delivering their shipment to Winterfall Village.

records.name: Arikara
records.objectives_text: Slay Arikara. Bring her remains and the Incendia Powder to Motega Firemane in Whitereach Post as proof of your deed.

records.name: General Drakkisath's Command
records.objectives_text: Take General Drakkisath's Command to Marshal Maxwell in Burning Steppes.

records.name: A Call to Arms: The Plaguelands!

wiki.page: A Call to Arms: The Plaguelands! (Alliance)

records.name: A Call to Arms: The Plaguelands!

wiki.page: A Call to Arms: The Plaguelands! (Alliance)

records.name: Clear the Way
records.objectives_text: Kill 10 Skeletal Flayers and 10 Slavering Ghouls in Sorrow Hill. Return to Commander Ashlam Valorfist at Chillwind Camp, Western Plaguelands.

records.name: A Call to Arms: The Plaguelands!
records.objectives_text: Seek out High Executor Derrington. His base camp is located at the Bulwark, east of Tirisfal Glades and the Undercity.

wiki.page: A Call to Arms: The Plaguelands! (Horde)

records.name: A Call to Arms: The Plaguelands!
records.objectives_text: Seek out High Executor Derrington. His base camp is located at the Bulwark, east of Tirisfal Glades and the Undercity.

records.name: A Call to Arms: The Plaguelands!
records.objectives_text: Seek out High Executor Derrington. His base camp is located at the Bulwark, east of Tirisfal Glades and the Undercity.

wiki.page: A Call to Arms: The Plaguelands! (Horde)

records.name: Scarlet Diversions
records.objectives_text: Proceed to the Scarlet Crusade's base camp between Felstone Field and Dalson's Tears and destroy their command tent. Place the Scourge banner at the camp, and then return to High Executor Derrington at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.

objectives.text: Destroy the command tent and plant the Scourge banner in the camp

records.name: All Along the Watchtowers
records.objectives_text: Using the :Beacon Torch, mark each tower in Andorhal; you will need to stand in the doorway of the tower to successfully mark it. Once all four towers are marked, return the Beacon Torch to Commander Ashlam Valorfist in Chillwind Camp, Western Plaguelands.

records.name: All Along the Watchtowers
records.objectives_text: Using the :Beacon Torch, mark each tower in Andorhal; you will need to stand in the doorway of the tower to successfully mark it. Once all four towers are marked, return the Beacon Torch to High Executor Derrington at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.

records.name: Lee's Ultimate Test Quest... of Doom!
records.objectives_text: Kill 6 sheep for Benny and then run like hell!

wiki.page: Lee's Ultimate Test Quest... of Doom!

records.name: General Drakkisath's Demise
records.objectives_text: Travel to Blackrock Spire and destroy General Drakkisath. Return to Marshal Maxwell when the job is done.

records.name: Hot Fiery Death
records.objectives_text: Someone in this world must know what to do with these gauntlets. Good luck!

records.name: High Chief Winterfall
records.objectives_text: Donova Snowden in Winterspring wants you to defeat High Chief Winterfall.

records.name: The Final Piece
records.objectives_text: Bring the Crudely-Written Log to Donova Snowden in Winterspring.

records.name: Fiery Plate Gauntlets
records.objectives_text: Bring Malyfous Darkhammer 6 Enchanted Thorium Bars, 2 Essence of Fire, and 4 Star Rubies. You will also need to turn in your Unfired Plate Gauntlets.

records.name: Lorax's Tale
records.objectives_text: Speak with Lorax. Listen to what he has to say.

records.name: The Demon Forge
records.objectives_text: Travel to Blackrock Spire and find Goraluk Anvilcrack. Slay him and then use the Blood Stained Pike upon his corpse. After his soul has been siphoned, the pike will be Soul Stained. You must also find the Unforged Rune Covered Breastplate. Return both the Soul Stained Pike and the Unforged Rune Covered Breastplate to Lorax in Winterspring.

records.name: Words of the High Chief
records.objectives_text: Take the Crudely-Written Log to Kelek Skykeeper in southern Felwood.

records.name: Little Pamela
records.objectives_text: Find Pamela Redpath in Darrowshire.

records.name: Elemental Leatherworking
records.objectives_text: Bring 2 Heart of Fire, 2 Globe of Water, 2 Core of Earth, and 2 Breath of Wind to Sarah Tanner in Searing Gorge. Completing this quest will give you access to the Elemental Leatherworking arts. The completion of this quest will prevent you from learning Dragonscale Leatherworking and Tribal Leatherworking; be sure this is the path you wish to follow before doing so.

records.name: Elemental Leatherworking
records.objectives_text: Bring 2 Heart of Fire, 2 Globe of Water, 2 Core of Earth, and 2 Breath of Wind to Brumn Winterhoof in the Arathi Mountains. Completing this quest will give you access to the Elemental Leatherworking arts. The completion of this quest will prevent you from learning Dragonscale Leatherworking and Tribal Leatherworking; be sure this is the path you wish to follow before doing so.

records.name: Wanted - Arnak Grimtotem
records.objectives_text: Slay Arnak Grimtotem and bring proof of your deed to Cliffwatcher Longhorn in Freewind Post.

records.name: Hypercapacitor Gizmo
records.objectives_text: Slay the beast and bring back the Hypercapacitor Gizmo and Panther Cage Key to Wizlo Bearingshiner.

records.name: Auntie Marlene
records.objectives_text: Speak with Marlene, south of the Ruins of Andorhal.

records.name: A Strange Historian
records.objectives_text: Bring :Joseph's Wedding Ring to Chromie.

records.name: The Annals of Darrowshire
records.objectives_text: Bring the :Annals of Darrowshire to Chromie in Andorhal.

records.name: Forces of Jaedenar
records.objectives_text: Enter Jaedenar and slay 4 Jaedenar Hounds, 4 Jaedenar Guardsmen, 6 Jaedenar Adepts, and 6 Jaedenar Cultists before returning to Greta Mosshoof in Felwood.

records.name: Verifying the Corruption
records.objectives_text: Seek out and destroy 2 Entropic Beasts and 2 Entropic Horrors while exploring Shatter Scar Vale. After checking to see if the craters there are still filled with corrupt fel water, return to Taronn Redfeather in Felwood.

objectives.text: Explore the craters in Shatter Scar Vale

records.name: Collection of the Corrupt Water
records.objectives_text: Take the Empty Canteen to the Moon Well in the center of Jaedenar and fill it before returning to Greta Mosshoof in Felwood.

records.name: Seeking Spiritual Aid
records.objectives_text: Take the Corrupt Moon Well Water to Islen Waterseer in the Barrens.

records.name: Cleansed Water Returns to Felwood
records.objectives_text: Take the Purified Moon Well Water to Greta Mosshoof in Felwood.

records.name: The Matron Protectorate
records.objectives_text: Travel to Winterspring and find Haleh. Give her Awbee's scale.

records.name: Wrath of the Blue Flight
records.objectives_text: Speak with Haleh if you wish to continue.

records.name: Wrath of the Blue Flight
records.objectives_text: Speak with Jeziba in the Plaguelands. He resides in Andorhal.

records.name: Are We There, Yeti?
records.objectives_text: Take Umi's Mechanical Yeti and scare her friends with it: Legacki in Everlook (Winterspring) Sprinkle in Gadgetzan (Tanaris) Quixxil in Marshal's Refuge (Un'Goro Crater) When you are done, bring the Mechanical Yeti back to Umi.

records.name: Catalogue of the Wayward
records.objectives_text: Read from the Catalogue of the Wayward.

records.name: Dousing the Flames of Protection
records.objectives_text: Using the Purified Moon Well Water, douse the flames of the four braziers of protection within Shadow Hold in Felwood, then return to Greta Mosshoof in the Emerald Sanctuary.

records.name: Breastplate of the Chromatic Flight
records.objectives_text: To forge the Breastplate of the Chromatic Flight, you will be required to bring the following items to Jeziba the 'Sculptor': 1 Chromatic Carapace. 10 Brilliant Chromatic Scales. 10 Blood of Heroes. 10 Frayed Abomination Stitchings.

records.name: Legplates of the Chromatic Defier
records.objectives_text: To forge the Legplates of the Chromatic Defier, you will be required to bring the following items to Jeziba the 'Sculptor': 1 Chromatic Carapace. 10 Brilliant Chromatic Scales. 10 Blood of Heroes. 5 Skin of Shadow.

records.name: Heroes of Darrowshire
records.objectives_text: Bring Davil's Libram and Redpath's Shield to Carlin Redpath.

records.name: Villains of Darrowshire
records.objectives_text: Bring the Skull of Horgus and the Shattered Sword of Marduk to Carlin Redpath at Light's Hope Chapel.

records.name: A Strange Red Key
records.objectives_text: Search through Jaedenar to discover what the Blood Red Key is used for.

records.name: Rescue From Jaedenar
records.objectives_text: Escort Arko'narin to where Lightforge and her equipment are being held, and then protect her as you escape Shadow Hold. Afterwards, seek out Jessir Moonbow in Felwood to let her know what's happened to her friends.

objectives.text: Protect Arko'narin out of Shadow Hold

records.name: Retribution of the Light
records.objectives_text: Return to Jaedenar and kill the succubus Rakaiah before finding the Remains of Trey Lightforge.

records.name: Marauders of Darrowshire
records.objectives_text: Bring 5 Resonating Skulls and the Mystic Crystal to Carlin Redpath in Eastern Plaguelands.

records.name: Brother Carlin
records.objectives_text: Bring the :Extended Annals of Darrowshire to Carlin Redpath in Eastern Plaguelands.

records.name: Defenders of Darrowshire
records.objectives_text: Free 15 Darrowshire Spirits and return to Carlin Redpath.

records.name: The Flesh Does Not Lie
records.objectives_text: Recover 10 Plagued Flesh Samples from Stratholme and return them to Betina Bigglezink. You suspect that any creature in Stratholme would have said flesh sample.

records.name: The Active Agent
records.objectives_text: Travel to Stratholme and search the ziggurats. Find and return new Scourge Data to Betina Bigglezink.

records.name: The Great Ezra Grimm
records.objectives_text: Find Ezra Grimm's smoke shop in Stratholme and recover a box of Grimm's Premium Tobacco. Return to Smokey LaRue when the job is done.

records.name: The Scourge Cauldrons
records.objectives_text: Speak with High Priestess MacDonnell at Chillwind Point, Western Plaguelands.

records.name: Target: Felstone Field
records.objectives_text: Go to Felstone Field in Western Plaguelands to locate and defeat the Cauldron Lord present there. It may have a key that will allow access to the cauldron. You must have the Empty Felstone Field Bottle with you to secure a sample of the poisons used inside the cauldron.

records.name: Target: Dalson's Tears
records.objectives_text: Go to Dalson's Tears in Western Plaguelands to locate and defeat the Cauldron Lord present there, and use its key to gain access to the cauldron. You must have the Empty Dalson's Tears Bottle with you to secure a sample of the poisons used inside the cauldron.

records.name: Return to Chillwind Camp
records.objectives_text: Bring the Filled Dalson's Tears Bottle to High Priestess MacDonnell at Chillwind Camp, Western Plaguelands.

records.name: Target: Writhing Haunt
records.objectives_text: Go to the Writhing Haunt in Western Plaguelands to locate and defeat the Cauldron Lord present there, and use its key to gain access to the cauldron. You must have the Empty Writhing Haunt Bottle with you to secure a sample of the poisons used inside the cauldron.

records.name: Return to Chillwind Camp
records.objectives_text: Bring the Filled Writhing Haunt Bottle to High Priestess MacDonnell at Chillwind Camp, Western Plaguelands.

records.name: Target: Gahrron's Withering
records.objectives_text: Go to Gahrron's Withering in Western Plaguelands to locate and defeat the Cauldron Lord present there, and use its key to gain access to the cauldron. You must have the Empty Gahrron's Withering Bottle with you to secure a sample of the poisons used inside the cauldron.

records.name: Return to Chillwind Camp
records.objectives_text: Bring the Filled Gahrron's Withering Bottle to High Priestess MacDonnell at Chillwind Camp, Western Plaguelands.

records.name: The Scourge Cauldrons
records.objectives_text: Speak with Shadow Priestess Vandis at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.

records.name: Target: Felstone Field
records.objectives_text: Go to Felstone Field in Western Plaguelands to locate and defeat the Cauldron Lord present there. It may have a key that will allow access to the cauldron. You must have the Empty Felstone Field Bottle with you to secure a sample of the poisons used inside the cauldron.

records.name: Return to the Bulwark
records.objectives_text: Bring the Filled Felstone Field Bottle to Shadow Priestess Vandis at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.

records.name: Target: Dalson's Tears
records.objectives_text: Go to Dalson's Tears in Western Plaguelands to locate and defeat the Cauldron Lord present there, and use its key to gain access to the cauldron. You must have the Empty Dalson's Tears Bottle with you to secure a sample of the poisons used inside the cauldron.

records.name: Return to the Bulwark
records.objectives_text: Bring the :Filled Dalson's Tears Bottle to Shadow Priestess Vandis at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.

records.name: Target: Writhing Haunt
records.objectives_text: Go to the Writhing Haunt in Western Plaguelands to locate and defeat the Cauldron Lord present there, and use its key to gain access to the cauldron. You must have the :Empty Writhing Haunt Bottle with you to secure a sample of the poisons used inside the cauldron.

records.name: Return to the Bulwark
records.objectives_text: Bring the :Filled Writhing Haunt Bottle to Shadow Priestess Vandis at The Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.

records.name: Target: Gahrron's Withering
records.objectives_text: Go to Gahrron's Withering in Western Plaguelands to locate and defeat the Cauldron Lord present there, and use its key to gain access to the cauldron. You must have the :Empty Gahrron's Withering Bottle with you to secure a sample of the poisons used inside the cauldron.

records.name: Return to the Bulwark
records.objectives_text: Bring the :Filled Gahrron's Withering Bottle to Shadow Priestess Vandis at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.

records.name: Uncle Carlin
records.objectives_text: Find Carlin Redpath.

records.name: A Final Blow
records.objectives_text: Kill Moora and Salia, and bring Shadow Lord Fel'dan's Head to Greta Mosshoof in Felwood.

records.name: Houses of the Holy
records.objectives_text: Travel to Stratholme, in the north. Search the supply crates that litter the city and recover 5 :Stratholme Holy Water. Return to Leonid Barthalomew the Revered when you have collected enough of the blessed fluid.

records.name: The Ruins of Kel'Theril
records.objectives_text: Speak with Jaron Stoneshaper in Starfall Village.

records.name: Troubled Spirits of Kel'Theril
records.objectives_text: Use Jaron's Pick to find the four Highborne Relic Fragments. Bring them to Aurora Skycaller in Eastern Plaguelands.

records.name: Fragments of the Past
records.objectives_text: Find the Sacred Highborne Writings in the Temple of Zin-Malor in Azshara, and bring them to Aurora Skycaller near the Northpass Tower in Eastern Plaguelands.

records.name: Fragments of the Past
records.objectives_text: Bring an Enchanted Thorium Bar, 5 Crystal Restore, and a Vial of Dire Water to Aurora Skycaller at Quel'Lithien Lodge, to the north-west of Northpass Tower in Eastern Plaguelands.

records.name: Tormented By the Past
records.objectives_text: Take the Crystal of Zin-Malor to Lake Kel'Theril in Winterspring and find a highborne spirit that will speak to you.

records.name: To Winterspring!
records.objectives_text: Find Starfall Village in and speak with Wynd Nightchaser.

records.name: Starfall
records.objectives_text: Find Starfall in Winterspring and speak with Wynd Nightchaser.

records.name: The Archivist
records.objectives_text: Travel to Stratholme and find Archivist Galford of the Scarlet Crusade. Destroy him and burn down the Scarlet Archive.

records.name: Remorseful Highborne
records.objectives_text: Speak with Wynd Nightchaser in Starfall Village, and ask about the proper place for the Crystal of Zin-Malor.

records.name: The Crystal of Zin-Malor
records.objectives_text: Deliver the Crystal of Zin-Malor to Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm in Darnassus.

records.name: Eagan Peltskinner
records.objectives_text: Speak with Eagan Peltskinner.

records.name: The Truth Comes Crashing Down
records.objectives_text: Take the Head of Balnazzar to Duke Nicholas Zverenhoff in the Eastern Plaguelands.

records.name: Above and Beyond
records.objectives_text: Venture to Stratholme and destroy Baron Rivendare. Take his head and return to Duke Nicholas Zverenhoff.

records.name: Lord Maxwell Tyrosus
records.objectives_text: Speak with Lord Maxwell Tyrosus. He is inside the church.

records.name: The Argent Hold
records.objectives_text: Open the Argent Hold and claim your reward.

records.name: The Restless Souls
records.objectives_text: Find Egan. You only know that he was last seen around Stratholme.

records.name: The Restless Souls
records.objectives_text: Use Egan's Blaster on the ghostly and spectral citizens of Stratholme. When the restless souls break free from their ghostly shells, use the blaster again - freedom will be theirs! Free 15 Restless Souls and return to Egan.

records.name: The Art of the Armorsmith
records.objectives_text: To become an Armorsmith, you must make the following items and return them to Grumnus: 4 Ornate Mithril Helms, 2 Ornate Mithril Boots, 1 Ornate Mithril Breastplate.

records.name: The Way of the Weaponsmith
records.objectives_text: To become a Weaponsmith, you must make the following items and return them to Ironus: 4 Moonsteel Broadswords, 4 Massive Iron Axes, 2 Heavy Mithril Axes, and 2 Big Black Maces.

records.name: The Art of the Armorsmith
records.objectives_text: To become an armorsmith, you must make the following items and return them to Okothos: 4 Ornate Mithril Helms, 2 Ornate Mithril Boots, 1 Ornate Mithril Breastplate.

records.name: The Way of the Weaponsmith
records.objectives_text: To become a Weaponsmith, you must make the following items and return them to Borgosh: 4 Moonsteel Broadswords, 4 Massive Iron Axes, 2 Heavy Mithril Axes, and 2 Big Black Maces.

records.name: Sweet Serenity
records.objectives_text: Travel to Stratholme and kill the Crimson Hammersmith. Recover the Crimson Hammersmith's Apron and return to Lilith.

records.name: Snakestone of the Shadow Huntress
records.objectives_text: Travel to Blackrock Spire and slay Shadow Hunter Vosh'gajin. Recover Vosh'gajin's Snakestone and return to Kilram.

records.name: Corruption
records.objectives_text: Find the Black Guard Swordsmith in Stratholme and destroy him. Recover the Insignia of the Black Guard and return to Seril Scourgebane.

records.name: The Sleeper Has Awakened
records.objectives_text: Escort Kerlonian Evershade to Liladris Moonriver at Maestra's Post in Ashenvale.

objectives.text: Escort Kerlonian Evershade to Maestra's Post

records.name: Barov Family Fortune
records.objectives_text: Venture to the Scholomance and recover the Barov family fortune. Four deeds make up this fortune: The Deed to Caer Darrow; The Deed to Brill; The Deed to Tarren Mill; and The Deed to Southshore. Return to Alexi Barov when you have completed this task.

records.name: The Last Barov
records.objectives_text: Travel to Chillwind Camp - Alliance territory - and assassinate Weldon Barov. Take his head and return to Alexi Barov. Be warned, Weldon will probably be well protected by Alliance scum.

records.name: Barov Family Fortune
records.objectives_text: Venture to the Scholomance and recover the Barov family fortune. Four deeds make up this fortune: The Deed to Caer Darrow; The Deed to Brill; The Deed to Tarren Mill; and The Deed to Southshore. Return to Weldon Barov when you have completed this task.

records.name: The Last Barov
records.objectives_text: Travel to the Bulwark - Horde territory - and assassinate Alexi Barov. Take his head and return to Weldon Barov. Be warned, Alexi will probably be well protected by Horde filth.

records.name: Family Tree
records.objectives_text: Deliver Cliffwatcher Longhorn Report to Nataka Longhorn at Ghost Walker Post in Desolace.

records.name: Hand of Iruxos
records.objectives_text: Retrieve the Demon Box from Thunder Axe Fortress, and return it, along with the Demon Pick to Taiga Wisemane in Shadowprey Village.

records.name: Doctor Theolen Krastinov, the Butcher
records.objectives_text: Find Doctor Theolen Krastinov inside the Scholomance. Destroy him, then burn the Remains of Eva Sarkhoff and the Remains of Lucien Sarkhoff. Return to Eva Sarkhoff when the task is complete.

records.name: Kirtonos the Herald
records.objectives_text: Return to the Scholomance with the Blood of Innocents. Find the porch and place the Blood of Innocents in the brazier. Kirtonos will come to feast upon your soul.

records.name: The Remains of Trey Lightforge
records.objectives_text: Return the Remains of Trey Lightforge to Jessir Moonbow in Felwood.

records.name: Catch of the Day
records.objectives_text: Talk to Jinar'Zillen at Shadowprey Village, and then bring Nataka Longhorn 2 Bloodbelly fish.

records.name: The Human, Ras Frostwhisper
records.objectives_text: Travel to the Arathi Highlands, to the ruins of Stromgarde. Search Stromgarde for a Keepsake of Remembrance. If you find such an item, return with it to Magistrate Marduke.

records.name: The Dying, Ras Frostwhisper
records.objectives_text: Travel to Light's Hope in Eastern Plaguelands and seek out Leonid Barthalomew the Revered. Show him the Keepsake of Remembrance and tell him all that you have discovered.

records.name: Menethil's Gift
records.objectives_text: Travel to Stratholme and find Menethil's Gift. Place the Keepsake of Remembrance upon the unholy ground.

records.name: Menethil's Gift
records.objectives_text: Take the Soulbound Keepsake to Leonid Barthalomew in Eastern Plaguelands.

records.name: Soulbound Keepsake
records.objectives_text: Return to Magistrate Marduke in Caer Darrow. Show him the Soulbound Keepsake.

records.name: The Lich, Ras Frostwhisper
records.objectives_text: Find Ras Frostwhisper in the Scholomance. When you have found him, use the Soulbound Keepsake on his undead visage. Should you succeed in reverting him to a mortal, strike him down and recover the Human Head of Ras Frostwhisper. Take the head back to Magistrate Marduke.

records.name: Gordo's Task
records.objectives_text: Collect 3 Gloom Weed and deliver them to Junior Apothecary Holland in the Brill graveyard.

records.name: Doom Weed
records.objectives_text: Collect 10 Doom Weed and deliver them back to Junior Apothecary Holland.

records.name: Bone Collector
records.objectives_text: Bring 10 Kodo Bones from the Kodo Graveyard to Bibbly F'utzbuckle at Kormek's Hut.

records.name: A Warden of the Horde
records.objectives_text: Purchase a Foam Sword Rack from Blax Bottlerocket in Orgrimmar's Drag. Then return your ward to the Orgrimmar orphanage by speaking with Orphan Matron Battlewail in The Drag.

prerequisites.wiki_text: You Scream, I Scream... (Horde) , Let's Go Fly a Kite (Horde)

records.name: Mantles of the Dawn
records.objectives_text: Bring 10 Argent Dawn Valor Tokens to .

records.name: Mold Rhymes With...
records.objectives_text: Bring the :Imbued Skeletal Fragments and 15 gold coins to Krinkle Goodsteel in Gadgetzan.

records.name: Krastinov's Bag of Horrors
records.objectives_text: Locate Jandice Barov in the Scholomance and destroy her. From her corpse recover Krastinov's Bag of Horrors. Return the bag to Eva Sarkhoff.

records.name: The Gordok Ogre Suit
records.objectives_text: Bring 4 Bolts of Runecloth, 8 Rugged Leather, 2 Rune Threads, and Ogre Tannin to Knot Thimblejack. He is currently chained inside the Gordok wing of Dire Maul.

records.name: Free Knot!
records.objectives_text: It's called the Gordok Shackle Key - well, that's what these "tons o' fun" keep calling it. I think any of the ogres might have it, but I'm not sure if any specific ones do. Maybe the guards have a better chance of having one... What am I talking about - you have it already, don't you?! Is that it there??!

records.name: Shards of the Felvine
records.objectives_text: Find the Felvine in Dire Maul and acquire a shard from it. Chances are you'll only be able to procure one with the demise of Alzzin the Wildshaper. Use the Reliquary of Purity to securely seal the shard inside, and return it to Rabine Saturna in Nighthaven, Moonglade.

records.name: A Reliquary of Purity
records.objectives_text: Travel to Silithus and search for a Reliquary of Purity within the ruins of Southwind Village. If you are able to find it, return with it to Rabine Saturna in Nighthaven, Moonglade.

records.objectives_text: A wonderful day has come. . You've reached the age in which our are trained in abilities only Night elves know. But it is not for me to train you. You must return to the Temple of the Moon and speak to Priestess Alathea as soon as your business here is concluded. She will test you to ensure you're prepared. and only then will she teach you Elune's Grace.

records.name: Of Love and Family
records.objectives_text: Travel to Stratholme, in the northern part of the Plaguelands. It is in the Scarlet Bastion that you will find the painting 'Of Love and Family,' hidden behind another painting depicting the twin moons of our world. Return the painting to Tirion Fordring.

records.name: Find Myranda
records.objectives_text: Travel to Uther's Tomb, located in the southern Plaguelands. Show Myranda the Hag Tirion's Gift.

records.name: Scarlet Subterfuge
records.objectives_text: Speak to Myranda to gain the Scarlet Illusion. Travel to Hearthglen while under the Scarlet Illusion and deliver Tirion's Gift to Highlord Taelan Fordring. Hearthglen is to the north, Taelan should be inside of Mardenholde Keep.

records.name: The Dunemaul Compound
records.objectives_text: Andi Lynn in Gadgetzan wants you to destroy the Dunemaul Compound by killing 10 Dunemaul Brutes, 10 Dunemaul Enforcers, and Gor'marok the Ravager.

records.objectives_text: Maggran wishes you to deliver a letter to Grish Longrunner at the Great Lift in the Barrens.
